purpose: Prove that the V19DH direct arrays can be serialized as valid OGIP products that reproduce official CIAO arrays and can be loaded and forward-folded by Sherpa.

writer.source_background: CIAO combine_spectra method=sum bscale_method=asca exp_origin=pha with every source/background response explicitly set to NONE
writer.arf: V19DH direct exposure-weighted array written as OGIP SPECRESP
writer.rmf: V19DH direct ARF-times-exposure-weighted dense array compressed once at the official addresp threshold
writer.pha_links: BACKFILE, ANCRFILE and RESPFILE rewritten to relative sibling product names before Sherpa loading

decision.pass: Both controls reproduce official CIAO source, background, ARF, RMF and EBOUNDS arrays exactly; exposure headers agree within 1e-12; OGIP structure checks pass; and Sherpa loads and forward-folds a finite positive model. A separately named full integrated/region commissioning may be frozen.
decision.fail: Do not run a full integrated combination or any spectrum fit. Repair only through a separately named implementation if the failure occurs before any comparison; otherwise retire the writer.

claim_boundary: V19DI is a writer and consumer-compatibility preflight, not a spectral or source result.
The two registered regions are development controls already used in V19DG/V19DH exploration; no new science target is opened.
No spectrum is fitted and no temperature, source invariant, lensing, halo, action, gravity parameter or holdout result is opened.
A pass authorizes a separately hash-frozen full commissioning runner; it does not authorize changing the V19X2 spectral model or gates.
